The default value on the new $mention parameter is unused because the only caller always passes it.

review.summary: The change adds an optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID config. It is checked against a strict 17-20 digit snowflake regex after trimming and appended as "\n<@ID>", with room reserved so truncation keeps the mention within 1800 characters. Docs, .env.example and the CHANGELOG are updated, and the tests cover valid, empty, invalid/injection and truncation cases. Only minor redundancy remains, so I would approve with nits.
